name: Honda Shadow Aero 750
engine: 745 cc liquid-cooled V-twin, carb (to 2009) or fuel injection (2010 on), shaft drive
intro: A very common Honda cruiser. Check the bank angle sensor recall on 2010-2016 bikes.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2007-2008 VT750s were in recall 08V141 for a fuel valve that can drip fuel. 2010-2016 Shadow 750s were in recall 15V874 because the bank angle sensor wire can rub through and stall the engine.
A-002.reason: A stall or a fuel leak is a crash or fire risk. Repairs are free.

G: 2004-2009 bikes have a carb. 2010 and later are fuel injected. Skip the steps that don't match your bike.

recalls.what: Bank angle sensor wire can rub on the harness and stall the engine.
Fuel control valve diaphragm may drip fuel.
